scope: Source-only trials through existing check entrypoints; no paid capacity, shared hook activation, deployment, account or security changes.
decision_policy: Every technique must be implemented or trialed. A rejection requires a source-bound attempt receipt, concrete failed acceptance criterion and measured result. Low ROI or absent pnpm, Vercel or Prettier is not evidence of inapplicability.
coverage_policy: Retain full required CI coverage, local compiler checks, existing producer/source/log receipt validation, all five shadcn diagnostic contract assertions and every configured lint rule.

trials.technique: Oxlint replacing applicable ESLint rules with diagnostic parity
trials.trial: Inventory the active rules and fixture diagnostics; pin Oxlint; compare normalized rule, severity, source range, message and repair guidance over clean and seeded-invalid fixtures. Trial native rules and supported JS plugins; retain the ESLint adapter for any unqualified custom rule.
trials.acceptance: No lost required diagnostic, unchanged clean acceptance, measured cold/warm time and RSS; replace only qualified rules. Test all six configured shadcn policies and all five current invalid-fixture assertions.
trials.reject_if: An executed parity fixture proves a missing or incorrect required diagnostic that cannot be repaired in the bounded adapter trial.

trials.trial: Execute the pinned native and frozen-lock npm distributions on eight copied Factory fixtures, preserving .d.mts classification. Require real formatting, three output-stable observations, idempotence and semantic comparisons. Native HTML no-target exit alone requests the mandatory qualified npm fallback. Existing browser CI retains actual Linux receipts; no repository-wide formatting or hook activation.
trials.acceptance: Idempotent output, unchanged runtime/contract tests, explicit supported-file inventory, measured cold/warm wall time and RSS; keep unsupported syntax on its current checker.

evidence.scope: Studio bounded eight-format fixture trial executed; committed-head and Linux hosted execution retained with the draft qualification. No adoption or repository-wide semantic claim.

trials.reject_if: A retained corpus demonstrates syntax, semantics or required-plugin incompatibility after the bounded configuration trial.

trials.technique: Type-aware lint in CI with actual compiler checks retained locally
trials.trial: Add pinned Oxlint type-aware/type-check shadow checks over real TS consumer fixtures and seeded unsafe assignments/promises. Retain local tsc, current CI compiler checks and all non-TS compiler checks while comparing diagnostics. Qualify the TS7-powered CI path before any replacement.
trials.acceptance: Compiler/type-aware diagnostic parity on real and invalid consumers, full retained compiler coverage, lower measured duplicate work; unsupported configs get a full compiler fallback.
trials.reject_if: A measured corpus proves an uncovered compiler error or incompatible required TS configuration after adapter testing.

trials.trial: Use qualified Oxfmt on explicitly edited supported files in an opt-in owned-worktree wrapper. Trial symlink, deleted-file, concurrent edit, ignored-file and formatter-failure cases. Generate shared-hook configuration for review without installing or activating it.
trials.acceptance: Only the owned edited paths change, repeated formatting is stable, failures are visible and concurrent edits are preserved; no shared hook or live V1 source is touched.
trials.reject_if: An actual edit replay shows corruption, unintended file changes or an unrepairable race.

trials.trial: Pin Microsoft's native compiler/LSP release and launch it in a disposable harness. Replay initialize/open/edit/diagnostics/definition/rename/shutdown against real exported consumer types; compare current language-service results. Prepare editor configuration without changing shared editor or agent settings.
trials.acceptance: Required diagnostics and navigation/rename results match, edit responses and RSS are measured, cancellation/shutdown leave no worker behind; disclose the upstream LSP implementation status.
trials.reject_if: An executed required-language-service case fails after bounded configuration repair.

trials.technique: One existing check entrypoint with bootstrap and affected checks plus full fallback
trials.trial: Extend existing commands rather than add a competing checker. Bootstrap missing dependencies using frozen locks in the owned checkout and create missing env templates from checked-in placeholders without credentials. Compute changed-path impact for lint/types/tests; unknown, deleted, config, dependency or unresolved graph changes trigger the full current command.
trials.acceptance: Missing-runtime/template fixtures recover deterministically, affected selection is source-bound and seeded dependency changes are caught; full required hosted checks remain complete and callers retain explicit full mode.
trials.reject_if: A measured impact/bootstrap fixture misses required coverage or changes another checkout despite bounded repair.

trials.technique: Shared maximum three heavy checks across worktrees
trials.trial: Reuse existing supervisor-bound leases with FIFO check tickets, a limit of three whole checks and inherited ownership for nested workers. Bind queue/wall time and owned-process RSS/CPU samples to existing verification receipts. Run deterministic fairness/cancellation/dead-owner/nesting fixtures and actual check entrypoint trials in multiple owned worktrees. Product-local adapters follow qualification without requiring the factory at product runtime.
trials.acceptance: At most three admitted whole checks, FIFO registered waiters, cancellation retires its own claim, live owners are never age-evicted, dead owners recover, nested workers cannot free the outer slot, and receipts retain source/log integrity. Existing CARR gate pool four and app/factory Node pool two remain intact.

evidence.scope: Factory whole-check admission only; product-local adapters remain planned.

trials.reject_if: Controlled trials show starvation, leaked/over-admitted leases, ownership errors or an unrepairable full-check regression.

trials.technique: Direct official-release installer instead of npm tool bootstrap
trials.trial: Use official pinned release artifacts for tools that publish them, verify supplied checksums/signatures and target architecture, and compare clean-cache install time with the current npm bootstrap. Install only into an owned trial tool directory; when an official binary is unavailable, trial the smallest official source/build equivalent and record the actual result.
trials.acceptance: Identical pinned tool behavior, verified provenance/integrity, measured installation time and no global PATH, credentials or security-setting changes.

evidence.scope: Pinned Oxfmt official native archive and frozen npm lock; integrity, architecture and version checked. Fresh/reused owned caches measured. Host caches uncontrolled; other tools/platforms remain planned.

trials.reject_if: The attempted official path has unavailable artifacts, unverifiable integrity or failed platform/behavior qualification.

trials.trial: Reuse the existing runner benchmark's source and retained-log binding. Confirm actual runner memory and run the exact type-consumer command on existing public standard Ubuntu capacity, which GitHub documents as 16GB; compare local/resource receipts and available baseline runner results. Do not provision paid larger runners.
trials.acceptance: Exact source/command parity, observed memory capacity, measured wall time/peak RSS/no OOM and retained full tests. If the existing account cannot supply the profile, record an actual eligibility failure and trial an owned 16GB process-memory envelope without claiming it equals a hosted runner.
trials.reject_if: Observed runner eligibility/capacity or an executed exact-source typecheck fails the declared target.

trials.trial: Run pinned native TS7 against existing declared exports and real consumer fixtures, seeded invalid consumers, JS/JSDoc inputs, declaration emit and project-reference build cases. Compare current TS6 command output and downstream consumption without migrating the package manager.
trials.acceptance: No missing required diagnostic, compatible declarations/build outputs and unchanged consumers, measured cold/incremental wall time and RSS; preserve current compiler fallback for unqualified cases.
trials.reject_if: A concrete required declaration/build/consumer case fails after a bounded adapter/configuration trial.

trials.technique: Previews only for DB-changing PRs with on-demand option and full CI retained
trials.trial: Source-only diff classification fixtures identify migrations/schema/DB contracts, including renames/deletions and unknown-impact fallback. Generate the equivalent existing-provider preview selector, with explicit on-demand dispatch, without adding Vercel or deploying. Run retained complete CI for every PR; only automatic preview provisioning is conditional.
trials.acceptance: Every seeded DB change requests a preview, explicit on-demand requests work for non-DB changes, uncertain impact is conservative and all required CI/E2E coverage is retained. Actual branch/preview provisioning waits for specific approval.
trials.reject_if: Executed classification/provider-adapter fixtures miss a DB change, lose on-demand behavior or weaken required CI.
